newsitem.title: USA: Terra Nitrogen sets cash distribution.
newsitem.headline: Terra Nitrogen sets cash distribution.

text.p: Terra Nitrogen Co Lp said Monday it set a cash distribution of $1.77 per senior preference unit and per common unit.

A Terra Nitrogen spokesman said the distribution is based on quarterly earnings. The $1.77 distribution includes $0.61 per unit from the the company's participation in an accounts receivable securitization facility.
The distribution is payable November 27 to unitholders of record as of November 6.
Earlier, Terra Nitrogen reported third quarter earnings of $1.31 per limited partnership unit, down from $1.45 a year ago.
Terra Nitrogen said earnings declined due to lower sales prices. Terra makes and markets nitrogen fertilizer products.
